card.name: Small words in Bayesian and general prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, to, in, over) and sometimes 'posterior' in running prose, especially in passages about Bayesian priors and posterior distributions. It also fires on scattered small words in other web text.

modes.label: Bayesian statistics text
modes.description: Linking word or 'posterior' just before 'posterior distribution' or a prior-related phrase.
modes.example: there may be no analytical solution for<< the>> posterior distribution.

modes.label: General web prose
modes.description: Small linking words in ordinary sentences with no shared topic.
modes.example: do not have enough space in the margin<< to>> fit my proof in.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are all simulation words, so it mildly steers away from saying simulation; the promoted tokens show no clear theme.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in text, most often in statistics passages on priors and posteriors.
